findings.title: Add's doc comment omits overflow behavior
findings.detail: Add has a one-line comment but never states what happens when a+b overflows the int range.
findings.risk_rationale: silent overflow could misfeed a downstream money calculation

findings.title: Greet does not trim surrounding whitespace from name
findings.detail: A name value like " Ada " renders as "Hello,  Ada ."; it should be trimmed first.
findings.risk_rationale: cosmetic only, no functional or safety impact

findings.title: Greeting formality beyond casual is not decided
findings.detail: Slice C set a casual tone, but whether to also add an exclamation mark or a time-of-day variant is still open.
findings.risk_rationale: the wrong formality reaches every caller of Greet

findings.title: ClampPercent and Clamp could share a bounds-check helper later
findings.detail: Not required now; noting for a future refactor once more percentage-style helpers exist.
findings.risk_rationale: no functional risk, purely a maintainability idea

summary: round 1: two fixes (one dismissed), one ask kept with a decision, one note
